notes: A fourteen-man battle royal crowns the fed's own first attested Heavyweight Champion; the undercard (several further named matches this pass's own commentary references but does not carry play-by-play for) is not individually structured, per the holdings bar and the serve-on-contextual-value rule. matches.stipulation: Fourteen-man battle royal for the vacant NMSEWF Heavyweight Championship
matches.note: Eleven further entrants were eliminated earlier in the match and are not individually structured. McQuaid went out third-from-last; Zagar eliminated Righteous last, at 38:41, to win the title.
